purpose: One final finite hypothesis-driven search; stop the PID family if no candidate passes.
WHY_EXPANDED: Round D exposed complementary axis behavior: candidate 007 had the highest success count (36/75) and 6/6 calm-axis acquisition but late y divergence; candidate 041 had 6/6 calm-axis acquisition and passed the 0.25 m RMSE threshold; candidate 035 had the lowest RMSE. The controller is per-axis, so recombining only observed axis parameter blocks directly tests whether these strengths coexist without widening any numerical range.
OLD_RANGE: 48 broad relative-velocity candidates followed by six full-Development finalists
NEW_RANGE: 18 exhaustive x/y/z donor combinations: x from {007,041,035}, y from {041,035}, z from {007,041,035}; scalar correction slew and integral limit are the arithmetic means of the three selected donor values
stop_rule: If none of the 18 candidates passes all frozen competence thresholds, return BLOCKED_V3_PID_TRADITIONAL_FAMILY with no further tuning.
